package io.github.xyz1001.pdsync.android;

import java.util.*;

/** Real Activity guard/read methods with deterministic scheduling and read-only I/O ports. */
class MainActivity {
    void invalidatePreparedOfficialNamespace() { }
    enum SyncPage { HOME, SETTINGS }
    enum OnboardingProgress { COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE }
    enum DiagnosticAction { INSPECT }
    enum DiagnosticStage { VERIFY }
    enum DiagnosticFailure { RECOVERY_REQUIRED, NONE }
    static class Text { String text() { return "checking saves"; } }
    static final Text CHECKING_SAVES_144 = new Text();
    static class SecureConnectionStore { static class Connection {} }
    static class SyncRuntime {
        static SecureConnectionStore.Connection account;
        static String selection, namespace;
        static boolean unavailable;
        static SecureConnectionStore.Connection currentConnection() { return account; }
        static String currentSelectionToken(MainActivity host) throws Exception {
            if (unavailable) throw new Exception("selection unavailable");
            return selection;
        }
        static String currentNamespace(MainActivity host) throws Exception {
            if (unavailable) throw new Exception("namespace unavailable");
            return namespace;
        }
    }
    static class Installer { boolean active; boolean hasActiveRequest() { return active; } }
    static class Readiness { String statusDescription() { return "not ready"; } }
    static class AutomaticHistory { boolean inFlight; Object ticket, connection; }
    static class AutoSyncStatusPolicy { static class Record {} }
    static class AutoSyncService {
        static AutoSyncStatusPolicy.Record beginManualInspection(MainActivity a) { return new AutoSyncStatusPolicy.Record(); }
        static void verifiedManualInspection(MainActivity a, AutoSyncStatusPolicy.Record record,
                AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection inspection) { a.verified++; }
    }
    static class Snapshot {
        final String id;
        Snapshot(String id) { this.id = id; }
        String getId() { return id; }
    }
    static class AppendCommit {
        final Snapshot snapshot;
        AppendCommit(String id) { snapshot = new Snapshot(id); }
        Snapshot getSnapshot() { return snapshot; }
    }
    static class SyncHistory {
        final List<AppendCommit> cloud = new ArrayList<>();
        List<AppendCommit> getCloud() { return cloud; }
        String getDefaultSnapshot() { return cloud.isEmpty() ? null : cloud.get(0).snapshot.id; }
    }
    interface Hook { void run() throws Exception; }
    interface Change { void run(MainActivity host) throws Exception; }
    interface Task { boolean run() throws Exception; }
    interface Done { void accept(boolean result) throws Exception; }
    static class AndroidSyncFacade {
        static class Inspection {
            String kind = "BOTH_EMPTY";
            String getKind() { return kind; }
            String getMessage() { return "fresh history"; }
            boolean getNeedsRestoreRecovery() { return false; }
            boolean isObjectVerified() { return true; }
        }
        final Inspection observed = new Inspection();
        final SyncHistory history = new SyncHistory();
        Hook inspectHook = () -> {}, historyHook = () -> {};
        int reads, historyReads;
        Inspection inspect() throws Exception { reads++; inspectHook.run(); return observed; }
        Inspection inspectHome() throws Exception { return inspect(); }
        AutoCloseable beginHomeReadIdentityScope() { return () -> {}; }
        SyncHistory historyPresentation(Inspection observation) throws Exception {
            check(observation == observed, "history must use this exact inspection");
            historyReads++; historyHook.run(); return history;
        }
    }
    static class SyncInspectionDiagnostics {
        enum Stage { RUNTIME, INSPECT, HISTORY }
        static Exception at(Stage stage, Exception error) { return error; }
    }
    static class InstallDiagnostics { static Object find(Exception error) { return null; } }
    static class PreparationDiagnostics { static Object find(Exception error) { return null; } }
    static class BridgeDiagnostics { static Object find(Exception error) { return null; } }
    static class DiagnosticLog { static void record(Object... arguments) {} }
    static class AndroidDiagnosticLogging { static Object inspectionResult(String kind, boolean failed) { return null; } }
    static class StaleArchiveReadException extends Exception {}

    SecureConnectionStore.Connection connection = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection();
    final HomeArchiveReadState archiveReads = new HomeArchiveReadState();
    final RenewalArchiveReadState renewalArchiveRead = new RenewalArchiveReadState();
    final Installer installer = new Installer();
    final Readiness readinessState = new Readiness();
    final AutomaticHistory automaticHistoryState = new AutomaticHistory();
    SyncPage page = SyncPage.HOME;
    OnboardingProgress progress = OnboardingProgress.COMPLETE;
    boolean resumed = true, destroyed, sharedAppreciationOnly, busy, available = true, ready = true;
    boolean cloudVerified = true;
    AndroidSyncFacade facade = new AndroidSyncFacade();
    AndroidSyncFacade nextFacade = new AndroidSyncFacade();
    AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection inspection = facade.observed;
    SyncHistory history = facade.history;
    Object homeObservationOwner = new Object();
    String notice = "old notice", details = "old details", selected = "old snapshot", explicitHomeSelection = selected;
    int workCalls, facadeCreations, published, verified, namespacePreparations, errors, renders;
    Task pendingTask;
    Done pendingDone;
    Boolean pendingValue;
    Exception failure;

    MainActivity() {
        SyncRuntime.account = connection; SyncRuntime.selection = "game-a"; SyncRuntime.namespace = "space-a";
        SyncRuntime.unavailable = false;
    }
    boolean isDestroyed() { return destroyed; }
    boolean homeAccountAccessAvailable() { return available; }
    boolean readyForSaves() { return ready; }
    boolean currentAutomaticHistory(Object ticket, Object account) { return account == connection; }
    String comparisonCopy() { return "comparison ready"; }
    String safeText(String value) { return value; }
    void render() { renders++; }
    void reportError(Exception error) { errors++; failure = error; }
    Object diagnosticInspectionDetails(AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection result) { return null; }
    Object currentHomeContext(int token) { return new Object(); }
    void publishArchiveReadState() { published++; }
    void prepareOfficialHomeNamespace(AndroidSyncFacade owner) { namespacePreparations++; }
    AndroidSyncFacade sync() {
        if (facade == null) { facadeCreations++; facade = nextFacade; }
        return facade;
    }
    void work(DiagnosticAction action, String label, Task task, Done done) {
        check(action == DiagnosticAction.INSPECT && "checking saves".equals(label), "reuse existing inspection work");
        check(!cloudVerified && inspection == null && history == null && homeObservationOwner == null,
                "manual read must clear old observation before worker");
        check(facade == null, "manual read must discard cached facade");
        check(!busy && pendingTask == null, "duplicate read queued");
        busy = true; workCalls++; pendingTask = task; pendingDone = done;
    }
    void runWorker() {
        Task task = pendingTask; pendingTask = null;
        check(task != null, "no worker queued");
        try { pendingValue = task.run(); } catch (Exception error) { failure = error; }
    }
    void finishWorker() throws Exception {
        Done done = pendingDone; pendingDone = null; busy = false;
        if (failure != null) {
            if (!(failure instanceof StaleArchiveReadException)) reportError(failure);
        } else {
            try { done.accept(pendingValue); }
            catch (Exception error) { reportError(error); }
        }
    }
    void runPending() throws Exception { runWorker(); finishWorker(); }
    // Scheduling port only; the real detached scheduler is exercised by test_detached_home_queue_execution.
    boolean startDetachedHomeRead(final SecureConnectionStore.Connection account, boolean prepare, boolean readiness, Object automatic) {
        final String selection=SyncRuntime.selection, namespace=SyncRuntime.namespace;
        this.cloudVerified=false;this.inspection=null;this.history=null;this.homeObservationOwner=null;this.facade=null;
        final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<Exception> readFailure=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<>();
        work(DiagnosticAction.INSPECT,CHECKING_SAVES_144.text(),()->{
            if(!isCurrentHomeRead(account,selection,namespace))throw new StaleArchiveReadException();
            if(!readyForSaves())return false;
            try{readComparison(prepare);return true;}catch(Exception failure){readFailure.set(failure);return false;}
        },value->{
            if(!isCurrentHomeRead(account,selection,namespace))return;
            if(readFailure.get() instanceof StaleArchiveReadException)return;
            if(readFailure.get()!=null)throw readFailure.get();
            if(!value){this.notice=this.readinessState.statusDescription();return;}
            this.notice=comparisonCopy();this.details=this.inspection==null?"":safeText(this.inspection.getMessage());
        });
        return true;
    }
    /* PRODUCTION_METHODS */

    static void check(boolean value, String message) { if (!value) throw new AssertionError(message); }
    static void terminal(MainActivity host) {
        check(!host.archiveReads.loading() && !host.busy, "terminal read left refresh locked");
        check(host.namespacePreparations == 0, "manual read provisioned the remote namespace");
    }
    static void guards() throws Exception {
        Change[] changes = {
            a -> a.connection = null,
            a -> a.progress = OnboardingProgress.INCOMPLETE,
            a -> a.resumed = false,
            a -> a.destroyed = true,
            a -> a.page = SyncPage.SETTINGS,
            a -> a.sharedAppreciationOnly = true,
            a -> a.busy = true,
            a -> a.archiveReads.begin(),
            a -> { a.automaticHistoryState.inFlight = true; a.automaticHistoryState.connection = a.connection; },
            a -> a.installer.active = true,
            a -> a.ready = false
        };
        for (int condition = 0; condition < changes.length; condition++) {
            MainActivity host = new MainActivity(); changes[condition].run(host);
            check(!host.canRefreshHomeHistory(), "manual refresh guard missing: " + condition);
            host.refreshHomeHistory();
            check(host.workCalls == 0 && host.facadeCreations == 0 && host.errors == 0,
                    "blocked manual entry queued I/O: " + condition);
        }
        MainActivity unrelated = new MainActivity(); unrelated.automaticHistoryState.inFlight = true;
        unrelated.automaticHistoryState.connection = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection();
        check(unrelated.canRefreshHomeHistory(), "another account's automatic loading must not block current HOME");
    }
    static void emptyUnknownHistoryAndRepeatedClicks() throws Exception {
        MainActivity host = new MainActivity();
        host.history = null; host.inspection = null; host.facade = null; host.homeObservationOwner = null;
        host.cloudVerified = false;
        check(host.canRefreshHomeHistory(), "no previous observation must remain refreshable");
        for (int click = 0; click < 10; click++) host.refreshHomeHistory();
        check(host.workCalls == 1 && host.facadeCreations == 0 && host.busy,
                "repeated clicks must coalesce before worker begins");
        host.runPending(); terminal(host);
        check(host.history != null && host.history.cloud.isEmpty() && host.cloudVerified && host.verified == 1,
                "confirmed empty history must publish a valid empty observation");
        check(host.facadeCreations == 1 && host.facade.reads == 1 && host.facade.historyReads == 1,
                "refresh must perform exactly one fresh inspect and paired history read");
        check(host.selected == null && host.explicitHomeSelection == null, "missing snapshot selection must clear");
        check(host.published == 2 && "comparison ready".equals(host.notice) && "fresh history".equals(host.details),
                "reuse existing loading and comparison feedback");
        AndroidSyncFacade first = host.facade;
        host.nextFacade = new AndroidSyncFacade(); host.nextFacade.history.cloud.add(new AppendCommit("new snapshot"));
        check(host.canRefreshHomeHistory(), "completion must permit an explicit subsequent refresh");
        host.refreshHomeHistory(); host.runPending(); terminal(host);
        check(host.workCalls == 2 && host.facadeCreations == 2 && host.facade != first && first.reads == 1,
                "subsequent refresh must replace rather than reuse previous facade");
        check(host.history == host.nextFacade.history && "new snapshot".equals(host.selected),
                "second refresh publishes newly observed cloud history");
    }
    static void unavailableCacheCanRetry() throws Exception {
        MainActivity host = new MainActivity(); host.available = false;
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
            check(host.canRefreshHomeHistory(), "unavailable cached access blocked foreground retry");
            host.nextFacade = new AndroidSyncFacade();
            host.nextFacade.inspectHook = () -> { throw new java.io.IOException("offline"); };
            host.failure = null; host.refreshHomeHistory(); host.runPending(); terminal(host);
            check(!host.cloudVerified && host.history == null, "failed retry retained observation");
        }
        host.nextFacade = new AndroidSyncFacade(); host.failure = null;
        host.refreshHomeHistory(); host.runPending(); terminal(host);
        check(host.cloudVerified && host.workCalls == 3 && !host.available,
                "foreground retry must read without treating cached access as authority");
    }
    static void manualConsumesPendingRenewal() throws Exception {
        MainActivity host = new MainActivity();
        host.renewalArchiveRead.open(host.connection, SyncRuntime.selection, SyncRuntime.namespace, false);
        host.renewalArchiveRead.started(); host.renewalArchiveRead.result(true);
        host.refreshHomeHistory(); host.runPending(); host.drainRenewalArchiveRead();
        check(host.workCalls == 1 && host.facade.reads == 1, "manual refresh must consume same-scope pending renewal");
    }
    static Change[] scopeChanges() {
        return new Change[] {
            a -> a.connection = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection(),
            a -> SyncRuntime.account = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection(),
            a -> SyncRuntime.selection = "game-b",
            a -> SyncRuntime.namespace = "space-b",
            a -> a.page = SyncPage.SETTINGS,
            a -> a.resumed = false,
            a -> a.destroyed = true,
            a -> a.sharedAppreciationOnly = true,
            a -> SyncRuntime.unavailable = true
        };
    }
    static void staleBeforeWorkerAndBeforeCompletion() throws Exception {
        Change[] changes = scopeChanges();
        for (int condition = 0; condition < changes.length; condition++) {
            MainActivity host = new MainActivity(); host.refreshHomeHistory(); changes[condition].run(host);
            host.runPending(); terminal(host);
            check(host.facadeCreations == 0 && host.failure instanceof StaleArchiveReadException && host.errors == 0,
                    "stale queued worker inspected or reported old scope: " + condition);
            check(host.history == null && !host.cloudVerified, "stale queued worker authorized old observation");
        }
        for (int condition = 0; condition < changes.length; condition++) {
            MainActivity host = new MainActivity(); host.refreshHomeHistory(); host.runWorker();
            changes[condition].run(host); host.notice = "new scope notice"; host.details = "new scope details";
            host.finishWorker(); terminal(host);
            check("new scope notice".equals(host.notice) && "new scope details".equals(host.details),
                    "stale completion overwrote new scope feedback: " + condition);
        }
        MainActivity foreignRuntime = new MainActivity(); SyncRuntime.account = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection();
        foreignRuntime.refreshHomeHistory();
        check(foreignRuntime.workCalls == 0 && foreignRuntime.history != null, "foreign runtime owner must reject before clearing history");
        MainActivity unavailable = new MainActivity(); SyncRuntime.unavailable = true; unavailable.refreshHomeHistory();
        check(unavailable.workCalls == 0 && unavailable.errors == 1 && unavailable.renders == 1,
                "scope failure must use existing error and rendering path");
    }
    static void staleDuringRead() throws Exception {
        Change[] changes = scopeChanges();
        for (int stage = 0; stage < 2; stage++) for (int condition = 0; condition < changes.length; condition++) {
            MainActivity host = new MainActivity(); Change change = changes[condition];
            Hook leave = () -> change.run(host);
            if (stage == 0) host.nextFacade.inspectHook = leave; else host.nextFacade.historyHook = leave;
            host.refreshHomeHistory(); host.runPending(); terminal(host);
            check(Boolean.FALSE.equals(host.pendingValue) && host.failure == null && host.errors == 0,
                    "stale in-flight read accepted or reported old scope: " + stage + "/" + condition);
            check(host.history == null && host.inspection == null && !host.cloudVerified && host.verified == 0,
                    "stale in-flight read polluted new observation: " + stage + "/" + condition);
            check(host.published == 2, "stale read failed to release loading state");
        }
    }
    static void failureAfterLeavingScope() throws Exception {
        Change[] changes = scopeChanges();
        for (int stage = 0; stage < 2; stage++) for (int condition = 0; condition < changes.length; condition++) {
            MainActivity host = new MainActivity();
            Hook fail = () -> { throw new java.io.IOException("old scope offline"); };
            if (stage == 0) host.nextFacade.inspectHook = fail; else host.nextFacade.historyHook = fail;
            host.refreshHomeHistory(); host.runWorker();
            check(Boolean.FALSE.equals(host.pendingValue), "failed read must defer its error until scoped completion");
            changes[condition].run(host); host.notice = "new scope notice"; host.details = "new scope details";
            host.finishWorker(); terminal(host);
            check(host.errors == 0 && host.failure == null && "new scope notice".equals(host.notice)
                    && "new scope details".equals(host.details), "late old-scope failure must not replace new feedback");
        }
        MainActivity invalidated = new MainActivity();
        invalidated.nextFacade.inspectHook = () -> invalidated.archiveReads.invalidate();
        invalidated.refreshHomeHistory(); invalidated.runPending(); terminal(invalidated);
        check(invalidated.errors == 0 && invalidated.failure == null && !invalidated.cloudVerified,
                "superseded read in same HOME must silently discard stale observation");
    }
    static void failureBlockedReadinessAndRetry() throws Exception {
        for (int stage = 0; stage < 2; stage++) for (Exception failure : List.of(
                new java.io.IOException("offline"), new InterruptedException("cancelled"))) {
            MainActivity host = new MainActivity();
            Hook fail = () -> { throw failure; };
            if (stage == 0) host.nextFacade.inspectHook = fail; else host.nextFacade.historyHook = fail;
            host.refreshHomeHistory(); host.runPending(); terminal(host);
            check(host.failure == failure && host.errors == 1 && !host.cloudVerified && host.history == null,
                    "failed refresh must preserve error and remove stale history");
            check(host.canRefreshHomeHistory() && host.published == 2, "failure must release refresh/loading for retry");
            host.failure = null; host.nextFacade = new AndroidSyncFacade();
            host.refreshHomeHistory(); host.runPending(); terminal(host);
            check(host.cloudVerified && host.workCalls == 2 && host.facadeCreations == 2,
                    "retry must recover through a fresh read");
        }
        MainActivity blocked = new MainActivity(); blocked.nextFacade.observed.kind = "BLOCKED";
        blocked.refreshHomeHistory(); blocked.runPending(); terminal(blocked);
        check(blocked.inspection != null && blocked.history == null && !blocked.cloudVerified
                && blocked.verified == 0 && blocked.nextFacade.historyReads == 0,
                "blocked read must remain unknown instead of authorized empty history");
        MainActivity readiness = new MainActivity(); readiness.refreshHomeHistory(); readiness.ready = false;
        readiness.runPending(); terminal(readiness);
        check(readiness.facadeCreations == 0 && "not ready".equals(readiness.notice),
                "readiness lost after click must stop before I/O and use existing feedback");
        MainActivity rotated = new MainActivity(); rotated.refreshHomeHistory();
        rotated.destroyed = true; rotated.archiveReads.close(); rotated.runPending(); terminal(rotated);
        MainActivity replacement = new MainActivity(); replacement.refreshHomeHistory(); replacement.runPending();
        terminal(replacement); check(replacement.cloudVerified, "replacement HOME must independently refresh after rotation");
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        guards(); unavailableCacheCanRetry(); emptyUnknownHistoryAndRepeatedClicks(); manualConsumesPendingRenewal();
        staleBeforeWorkerAndBeforeCompletion(); staleDuringRead(); failureAfterLeavingScope(); failureBlockedReadinessAndRetry();
        System.out.println("Manual HOME history refresh execution passed");
    }
}
